# The Sheema Edit

Official website: https://thesheemaedit.com/
Creator: Rasheema Abdullah
Known as: Sheema

The Sheema Edit is an independent personal blog created by Rasheema Abdullah, also known as Sheema. It covers mental wellness, unmasking, motherhood, chronic illness, lifestyle, beauty, family life, and funny real life stories.

## What the site contains

The website publishes personal essays called “Edits.” It also includes Shop The Edit with digital products and tools.

What Do I Say? is an online message wording tool by The Sheema Edit. It helps users write a message, reply to a message, clean up a draft, and adjust tone for everyday conversations, work, boundaries, apologies, cancellations, follow ups, customer service, and relationship conversations. The founding beta includes three free messages on a device and a $19.99 one time Lifetime Access offer for the first 100 customers before a planned $9.99 monthly regular plan.

The shop also includes The Sheema Edit Reflection Journal, Gentle Weekly Planner, and Reset Bundle, plus a one time Support The Edit option.
